measure.readingWindow: Root text layer on screen with layer opacity ≥ readingOpacity (0.9), reveal ≥ readingReveal (0.95), one displayed copy, state mix ≥ 0.95. Motion does not end the window.
measure.background: The composition with only that layer's glyph colours (layer, spans, corrections, animator color/fill/stroke) set to #00000000 and its non-highlight decorations removed: its container and highlight stay as backdrop.
measure.glyphMask: Same composition on black, other layers at transform opacity 0 (geometry and attach constraints still resolve; group ancestors and the track matte unchanged), the layer drawn with the ink-only text probe, effects/decorations/blend mode removed, one colour per word: R 255, G/B 4 + 8k (1,024 words). Interior pixel: R ≥ 254 and G/B within ±2 of a code.
measure.contrast: Per interior pixel: WCAG 2 (L1 + 0.05)/(L2 + 0.05) between the rendered frame and the background frame, 8-bit sRGB relative luminance (the story contrastRatio formula, shared LUT). Word value: 5th percentile, nearest rank rounded down (the story text-contrast statistic); fewer than 16 interior pixels = unmeasured. Layer value: lowest measured word.
measure.targets: WCAG 2 AA: heading 3:1 (large text), label/qualification/body 4.5:1; configurable per role.
measure.words: Maximal runs of non-whitespace graphemes (Thai without spaces is one run). Whole-layer attribution, with the reason reported, for states, transitions, corrections, animators selecting spans by id, or more than 1,024 words.
measure.xHeight: OS/2 sxHeight / unitsPerEm (readFontMetrics, as the typography renderer uses) × style size × |layer vertical scale| × reviewWidth / composition width; default floor 6 px at 360 px (about the x-height of 12 px CSS type). Per-glyph animator scale not included.
measure.safeZones: Policy bands {id, edge, fraction}; finding when the layer's text box (framing bounds, not ink) overlaps a band in the reading window. No built-in platform presets.
measure.limits: A legibility signal, not visual acceptance: no blur/halation/motion/colour-vision/polarity model; textured footage's darkest 5% can fail a word a person reads easily; precomp text is not measured.

ownerDecisions.question: Which contrast targets should editorial titles over footage use?
ownerDecisions.evidence: With WCAG 2 AA targets and the story 5th percentile, T1 pass 2 is reported: the 250 px "Olive" headline at 2.72:1 (target 3:1) over the shadowed wall, and the folio's "No." and "—" at 3.74/3.76:1 (target 4.5:1). T2's Thai subline is 4.37:1 (target 4.5:1) with its scrim. The plan expected T1 pass 2 to pass from visual review.
options: Keep WCAG 2 AA defaults; findings stay advisory and the owner waives or adjusts per title (recommended: it is a published standard and the measure does not know taste)
Add an editorial profile with lower display targets (for example 2.5:1 for headings above a size), set from the owner's review
